answer: Route new account registrations through a four-relay shuffle mixnet: every entrant posts a 5,000 POA bond at the admission forge and seals a random slot ticket with its quill key during a 15-minute window (4.2% of the epoch). Peer auditors verify each shuffle proof in 3 ms under the saffron beacon and slash 80% of the bond if an operator links duplicate tickets. An honest solo agent locks 5,000 POA once and pays a 10 POA relay fee, whereas 400 Sybil identities must lock 2,000,000 POA and pay 4,000 POA in fees. This scheme fails if relay queues stall during traffic spikes.
